benchmarks.name: one_week_recent_trend
benchmarks.note: Linear continuation of the prior week's +28.12 point S&P move; fixed prospectively at creation.

original_forecast.resolution_rule: Up-event succeeds if the official/index-provider or consistently sourced S&P 500 close on 2026-08-21 exceeds the 2026-08-14 close of 7,785.76. Resolve the point estimate and 80% interval against the same close source.
rationale: H001 retains only a narrow lead after the retail/control-group miss raised H002, so the weekly directional probability is slightly below even rather than extrapolating record-level momentum.
Benign July PPI and low layoffs lower immediate policy-tightening risk, which offsets part of the growth downside.
Renewed oil/geopolitical pressure creates a two-sided tail through household purchasing power, inflation expectations, and long yields.
Upcoming industrial production, housing data, FOMC minutes, and earnings can discriminate among the competing growth/inflation paths.
surprising_if: SPX closes outside the stated 80% interval without a major new exogenous shock.
Growth data materially deteriorate while long yields do not fall and SPX nonetheless rises strongly without broad earnings confirmation.

resolution.source: Associated Press market close report published 2026-08-21: S&P 500 closed at 7,674.37, down 111.39 points for the week from the frozen Aug. 14 reference close of 7,785.76.
resolution.audit_note: Forecast content above is preserved without hindsight alteration. The weekly up-event resolved FALSE. The direction probability was only marginally informative, while the point forecast modestly beat both frozen point benchmarks despite a large absolute miss. The 80% interval covered. Scoring was completed before post-Aug. 20 evidence was used for model revision.
